content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version appears to have leaked several upcoming Apple home products, including an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a Siri Remote designed for the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad device.

After in-depth code analysis, several important clues about the HomePad specifications have also emerged...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that the HomePad will likely run a variant of tvOS, but its operation may more closely resemble a giant Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather interesting privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to launch in two versions: one with a base speaker, resembling a HomePod; the other designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, there are other yet-unknown devices mentioned. I sincerely hope they include a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
